svg.title: The memory check
svg.desc: Before the action, the harness starts a counter that adds 1 every 0.5 s, fills 32 MiB of RAM with random bytes, and writes down the process ID, the RAM hash and the count. After a pause, snapshot or fork, it passes only if the same process is running, the RAM is unchanged and the count is still rising. A restarted sandbox fails: a new process, empty RAM, a stuck count.
